debit.notes: Customer care is 24x7 (the bank advertises a '24/7 Helpdesk at +91 1800 425 1444 (Toll-free)'); both 1800 lines are toll-free within India, 080-220 21555 is the published NRI line, and +91 802 202 1500 is the chargeable contact-centre number named in the bank's debit-card loss guidance. The bank instructs blocking a lost/stolen debit card 'using the Internet, mobile banking channels' (KBL MoneyClick netbanking or the KBL Mobile Plus app) but publishes no app menu path. No SMS hotlist format is published on official pages; missed-call lines 1800 425 1445 (balance) and 1800 425 1446 (mini statement) are not card-block channels.

credit.notes: The bank's lost/stolen guidance covers credit cards jointly with debit cards: email info@ktkbank.com detailing the situation or call the two toll-free numbers, which are advertised as a 24/7 helpdesk. No netbanking, app or SMS block path is published for credit cards. WhatsApp chat +91 9632188999 is listed on the contact page but is not advertised as a card-block channel.

upi.notes: No in-app UPI lock/freeze or deregister menu path is published on the bank's website — the BHIM KBL UPI app page lists only a five-step registration flow and general FAQs. Published freeze route (customer-awareness page): 'If your mobile device gets stolen, get your mobile banking applications blocked by calling our contact center at +91 1800 572 8031 (Toll-free), +91 802 1500 or contact our nearest branch for assistance' — this blocks the bank's mobile apps (BHIM KBL UPI app / KBL Mobile Plus), not a UPI-specific switch; 'You may get it unblocked once you recover your lost phone or buy a new one.' On credential compromise the bank says 'Please lock your user access immediately' and points to the contact centre at +91 1800 572 8031 (Toll-free), +91 802 202 1500. The KBL BHIM UPI app page footer lists toll-free +91 1800 425 1444 (the advertised 24/7 Helpdesk) and +91 1800 572 8031; fraud emails go to isecurity@ktkbank.com. No netbanking (MoneyClick) UPI manage/disable path and no SMS/USSD keywords for UPI are published; the Android BHIM KBL UPI app is distributed by the bank as a direct APK with published checksums (v1.5.7), no app-store listing. The bank's UPI safety guidance: 'you do not have to enter your PIN to receive money via UPI... If in doubt, reject the transaction.'
